Hair Color Pattern - Neon Accent Hair.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Apply the selected secondary hair color using a neon accent hair pattern. If no secondary hair color is selected, keep the pattern subtle or skip it rather than inventing an unrelated color.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
